item.title: [ 5 Maps ] The Parish Spooktober Halloween Edition
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
The Parish, but in a Halloween theme! Explore and fight through the broken, dark haunted towns of Louisiana! Filled with mysterious, iconic killers, pumpkins and haunted areas of New Orleans! - If custom sounds do not work, make sure to do "snd_rebuildaudiocache" through console. - The file size being large is due to the Halloween packs. If this a bother to you guys, I'll try to reduce the models and materials. - If you still get errors and missing textures still from the packs, make sure any custom maps and major addons is disabled. (Still investigating this issue. I have not yet encountered this problem, although a clean vanilla of the game should work regardless.) - If your skybox is showing full purple, make sure to put your settings in High or Very high. Valve - Maps, Presets & Assets death. by dolls ꔫ - Audio Remixing & Mapping Creation, Thumbnails iamDeanPC - Inspired & based off of "The Parish Bridge: Halloween Edition" NvC_DmN_CH – Pumpkin Models isaur – Candle Models E7ajamy – Whirlpools FOXY.BONNIE & Stefano, Klément Bruker - Halloween Decors Packs Monste-Official & G011d3n, syntheticplants - Halloween Decors EXTRA SAW Model (Billy) – Shadowsun™ & CS_Insertion miser
